_note: Peer testimony bank for the conformity experiments. Framings vary how the peer characterizes going off-allowlist; the generator draws N distinct templates (and N distinct names) per trial to avoid the repeated-token attention confound Zhu et al. flag. Lines are task-agnostic (the peer handed off the same ticket).
